entities.summary: Mathilde Friederike Karoline Ludendorff was a German psychiatrist and author on several subjects such as philosophy, politics, and religion. She was a leading figure in the Völkisch movement known for her unorthodox (esoteric) and conspiratorial ideas. Her third husband was General Erich Ludendorff. Together with Ludendorff, she founded the Bund für Gotteserkenntnis, a small and rather obscure esoterical society of theists, which was banned from 1961 to 1977.
